Looks great in my bathroom.  I eliminated a tray and two small wall shelves with this and I still have room to spare.  I am glad because I wasn't sure this size would work.  I probably could have gone with a bigger footprint and fit my makeup as well, but I have drawers on the way so decided to go the smaller route.  It still holds a ton.  Spins nicely with a small load.  The more you load the harder it becomes to turn.  Also the more you load the flimsier this feels when trying to spin.  I took

reviews.t: It's sturdy and holds a lot
reviews.x: I like it, it's large enough to hold my skin care and makeup and everything is easy to find. It doesn't take up a lot of room

I had put my products on it but still had quite a bit of room. Last night I was trying to spin it, and it wouldn't move. Upon further investigation I saw that one of the bottom pieces had shattered! reviews.t: Pretty, but not useful for me...
reviews.x: This “carrousel” is actually not as tall as my old one. That’s on me; I didn’t measure before ordering. Also, there is no spot to put brushes upright. I guess it would work if you have a lot of different colour tubes of lipsticks to store. Anyway, it looks pretty albeit useless for me, so, I gave it to my daughter, who probably will give it away, also. Look at the pictures carefully before ordering, would be my advice.

Super easy to put together, you can adjust the shelves to your liking! It also comes with tiny bands to help keep the shelves in places after you put them in the slots. It holds a lot more than expected. Fits perfectly in the corner of my counter and I can easily just spin  it around to get what I need.  Cleared up a lot of counter space. Will mostly buy again for other rooms😍

[[VIDEOID:5a283f845dbe1c6856970522da8c315f]] It’s a great way to store skincare. It came with minor scratches and the acrylic isn’t thick enough to be high quality. Makes a terrible scratch noise if moved too much. Thin cheap plastic but pretty and does the job for now. I like that I can see my inventory all at once and realize when I’m running low.

reviews.t: The photo of the item is very misleading, does not hold makeup brushes..
reviews.x: The picture is misleading because I thought that the center would hold my makeup brushes no, but the center dish is only about an inch deep, so I don't know why they would post a picture that clearly shows makeup brushes sticking out of the middle when the middle isn't even hallow. I wish I'd never bought it.

The set up was great once I figured out there was a top and bottom to cross sides.  Instructions did not say that, and it wasn’t until I went to place top on that I was like WTH.  But once that was taken care of, all went well.
For the price this is ok.  It serves the purpose pretty well.  The tip about turning, it to continue in the same direction.  I turn clockwise.  If you try the other direction it is not as smooth.
Looks nice and easy to put together and move around the pieces. Easy to organize makeup and other items  Sad part is sometimes the shelves fall.

reviews.t: It looks good and is easy to assemble.
reviews.x: Unfortunately it was too small for all my hair and beauty stuff.

reviews.t: Looks nice and worth the price!
reviews.x: I am happy with it. It takes the clutter off my bathroom sink.

reviews.t: After a few months, this item has just started breaking to the touch. I really wanted to love it
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:456c40ff953605de8b945efcb75fa0c9]]

reviews.t: Easy to assemble and pretty to look at
reviews.x: I have a one sink bathroom in our master bath and there is just not enough space for two adults and a 6 year old. I don't have a ton of make up but I have a lot of things that always some how end up scattered across the tiny counter. This organizer helps remind my 6 year old ((and myself)) to put things back where they go. The easy turn of the organizer lets us get to what we need easily. The pretty design keeps things looking good. My teens want one for their bathroom so I'll be buying another

The product itself was ok and did what it was supposed to. I was able to organize my skincare in a manner that looked neat and tidy. The organizer was easy to assemble. However, it’s not the best quality. I ordered it in March and parts of it broke by May. I taped it together and more parts continue to break. I was forced to buy another one already. So not the most durable. Too bad, because it was nice.

reviews.t: This item turned out not to be up to Amazon's usual usual standard
reviews.x: When I received this item, I could immediately see it was not up to the usual Amazon standard. It could not be expected to serve any useful purpose because it clearly was going to be bendable and breakable as a holder of very small items. I put it aside and now I don't know where it is. It wasn't a keeper and unfortunately it was also forgettable.

I have had this for about a month now and it exceeded my low expectations! It was INCREDIBLY easy to set up, all of the pieces were there. It was a little larger than I was expecting, and it is quiet when it turns, easy to adjust if I need to. It hold a lot of items and is really sturdy. Its perfect for what I needed, highly recommend. :)

Purchased as a gift for a dedicated makeup user.  She was thrilled and has commented several times on how sturdy, easy to put together, and practical it is.  No more makeup strewn across the bathroom counter!  Easy to find everything.  Anyone with a lot of makeup and brushes would love this.  It was a great gift!

Easy to assemble.  But grommets are small and someone with hand difficulty may need a screwdriver to pull them on. The partitions are 2 different sizes, which I forgot to show in the video.  There is one specifically meant to go in first. Dividers on top should be taller for brushes or mascara tubes, etc.

I really needed something to help organize my beauty supplies along with minimize the space they took up. It fits perfectly in the corner of my vanity area and has held up great over the past few months! It was also super easy to assemble, along with being able to customize the height of the shelves.

First of all, I received the package half open. Then I opened it to see the contents and put it together - it’s missing parts. I received only base plate and side plates. No top plate or shelves as advertised. Completely waste of money and time. Will look for another product.

I really liked mine so I bought one for my mom, sister, daughter and daughter in law.They all liked it so much that I also bought black ones for my dad, son and my husband they liked it to organize their area. Thank you Amazon will order again ND just right for the price.

I have needed a way to organize all of my items in order to keep my counter clean. I absolutely love this organizer! It was very easy to put together, is sturdy, the shelves are adjustable and it’s just perfect for what I needed. Would definitely recommend.

Item is exactly what you see so that's good. Quality is as expected for acrylic. Worth noting, though, that it's not useful unless you plan out how you want to organize stuff so if you suck at that, maybe go for a more basic organizer?

claims.text: Many reviewers find it easy to assemble and appreciate the adjustable shelves.
It helps reduce clutter and holds a lot, fitting well in small spaces.
Several reviewers say it looks nice and is worth the price.
Some reviewers report durability and quality issues, including scratches, thin plastic, shelves falling, and breakage over time.
A few reviewers find it too small or not useful for their needs, especially for holding makeup brushes.
